title: fix(plugin-grid): the import preview reads dates, rating/slider/progress/toggle and email as the server does (objectui#11889)
body:
Fixes #11889
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

The Import Wizard preview's cell check (`checkImportCell` in `packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx`) now marks a cell exactly where the server's import refuses it on the three legs the card names, so the import button (which counts the rows nobody flagged) counts what the import will write.

- **Dates (was looser).** A `date` / `datetime` cell is judged by `isImportableDateCell` in `importCoercionContract.ts`, a mirror of `@objectstack/core`'s `parseDateCell` grammar (`readIsoTemporalCell`, then `readYearFirstCell`, with `namesRealCalendarDay` and the clock ranges) plus core's supported years, which the engine's write validation applies to the stored value. `07/15/2026`, `July 15, 2026` and `1/2/26` are now marked `invalid_date`; `2026-07-15` and `2026/7/15` are taken. The spec publishes neither the grammar nor the years, so both are restated beside the boolean tokens, with a paired inventory in `importCoercionContract.test.ts` as the tripwire. A zone-bearing ISO cell is judged with the UTC setters, never with the browser's own date parser.
- **rating, slider, progress, toggle (were unchecked).** The boolean and numeric arms key on the spec's `BOOLEAN_VALUE_TYPES` and `NUMERIC_VALUE_TYPES` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, the sets the server's `coerceFieldValue` reads, instead of literal case lists. The arms run in the server's order (boolean, numeric, date, then the rest).
- **Email (was stricter).** An `email` cell is judged by `isRecordEmail`, a one-pass restatement of the record validator's `EMAIL_RE`, which takes `735431496@柴仟.com` and still refuses `a@b`. `isPlausibleEmail` (the identity rule, not a package export) is removed: see the measurement below.

No export, prop, accepted input or sentence changes; `cellRefusalMessage` is untouched. Changeset: `.changeset/11889-import-cell-check.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch).

## What was measured

All server sources read at the tag `@objectstack/core@17.7.0` (the same commit as `@objectstack/objectql@17.7.0` and `@objectstack/spec@17.7.0`, `4e4e8814`).

- **The pinned spec exports both sets.** objectui's lockfile resolves `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0: `NUMERIC_VALUE_TYPES` = number, currency, percent, rating, slider, progress, summary; `BOOLEAN_VALUE_TYPES` = boolean, toggle. The range floor `^17.5.0` exports both as well (the 17.5.0 tarball's `data` entry), and `check:spec-floors` judged the built plugin-grid with no finding.
- **H1 (the date grammar): confirmed, with one correction.** For `date` / `datetime`, `parseDateCell` takes `readIsoTemporalCell(s) ?? readYearFirstCell(s)` and nothing else. The supported years (`date` 0001 to 9999, `datetime` 1000 to 9999) are refused in two places, both with `invalid_date`: at coercion only for a cell the reader already refuses (`outsideYears` changes the sentence, not the verdict), and at the engine's write validation for a cell the reader takes (`0500-07-15` into a `datetime`). The mirror carries both. A `time` cell has its own reader, and the preview does reach `time`: see "Not in this PR".
- **The date mirror against the published server.** A one-off probe compared `isImportableDateCell` with the published `@objectstack/core` 17.7.0 `coerceFieldValue` followed by the write door's temporal rule, over 43,212 (cell, kind) pairs (the server takes 3,395 of them). Disagreements: 0, under three host zones (UTC, Asia/Shanghai, America/New_York). Control: the old `Date.parse` rule disagrees on 16,107 of the same pairs, so the comparison can fail. The probe is not committed; the inventory is.
- **H2 (`summary`): harmless.** Neither host offers a `summary` target: `importTargetFields` drops `formula` / `summary`, and `ExcelImportBar` drops `formula` / `summary` / `autonumber`. The server's coercion reads the same set, so a host that did pass one would get the server's answer.
- **H3 (the email rule): confirmed.** `record-validator.ts` declares `EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@.]+(?:\.[^\s@.]+)+$/` and an `email` cell passes coercion untouched. The mirror is a single pass (no pattern, no backtracking), and `importEmailValidation.test.ts` compares it with that literal and keeps the adversarial-input timing pin.
- **Can this wizard import into an identity object? Yes, and the strict rule never reached it.** `ObjectView` wires `sys_user` to `/api/v1/auth/admin/import-users` for an admin. But that target's email column reaches the wizard typed `text` (`identityImportFields`), so `checkImportCell`'s email arm never ran on it, before or after this PR. The identity endpoint applies `isLikelyEmail` in its own dry run (its identity pre-validation runs for `dryRun`). So the record validator's rule applies alone in the email arm, and `isPlausibleEmail` had no caller left.

## Tests

On `2867a40` (this branch merged with `origin/main` `9844bbf`):

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter "@object-ui/plugin-grid..." build`: exit 0 (15 of 47 projects).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check`: exit 0. The test program (`tsconfig.test.json`) lists all three edited test files.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/`: 193 files, 1818 tests passed. This includes every `ImportWizard*`, `importCoercionContract*`, `importParsers*` and `importEmailValidation*` suite. There is no `*.guard.test.*` in the package.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`: all exit 0.
- `check:spec-floors`: exit 1, NOT MEASURED for the workspace. All 13 findings are `no-artifact`, for packages outside this build closure. plugin-grid was built and judged, with no finding.
- ESLint on the five edited files: 0 errors. 9 warnings, all outside the diff hunks.

New pins (`ImportWizard.cellCheck-11889.test.tsx`): each spelling the card names, with a control per leg. The preview marks the cells and the import button reads `Import 1 Row` for each leg.

**Reverse check per leg.** Each fix was committed first, then mutated through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 to 0 on disk, blob changed) and restored (blob equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty):

| Leg | Mutation | Result | Direction |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dates | arm back to `Date.parse` | 2 failed, 7 passed: `date 07/15/2026: expected undefined to deeply equal { code: 'invalid_date' …}`, and the preview's row 2 date not marked | unmarked, so overcount (predicted) |
| Types | literal `boolean` and `number`/`currency`/`percent` case lists | 3 failed, 6 passed: rating/slider/progress, toggle, preview count | unmarked, so overcount (predicted) |
| Email | the old identity rule inline | 2 failed, 7 passed: `expected { code: 'invalid_email' … } to be undefined`, and the preview's non-ASCII row marked | marked, so undercount (predicted) |

The first email run never acquired the shared verify lock (queue timeout, exit 99, tree restored), so it measured nothing. The second run is the one above.

## Acceptance notes (not changed here)

- **The supported-years sentence.** A cell refused only for its year (`0500-07-15` in a `datetime`) reads "is not a valid date" in the preview, where the server names the range. A range sentence needs a new `grid.import.*` key, and `packages/i18n` is outside this card's fence. Handover: none.
- **A zone-naive `datetime` is read as UTC.** The server reads it in the importing user's business timezone, which the wizard does not know. The two disagree only within a day of year 1000 or 9999.
- **The boolean tokens are published now.** `@objectstack/spec` exports `IMPORT_BOOLEAN_TRUE_TOKENS` / `IMPORT_BOOLEAN_FALSE_TOKENS` (at 17.5.0 and 17.7.0) and `IMPORT_REFERENCE_TYPES`. `importCoercionContract.ts` still mirrors the tokens under a "not published yet" note. The contents are identical today, so nothing is wrong yet. Handover: none.
- **Numeric bounds.** A field's own `min` / `max` are not judged by the preview for any numeric type, as before, because the wizard's field shape does not carry them. The dry run judges them.

## Not in this PR (reported to the seat)

- **A `time` column is not checked.** `importTargetFields` passes `time` fields through. The preview takes every cell (`25:00`, `abc`, `10:00Z`, `9am` all measured as taken), while the published 17.7.0 server refuses those four with `invalid_time`. A fix needs core's `time` rule mirrored and an `invalid_time` refusal with a sentence, which is outside this card's fence.
- **The user import's preview checks no email.** Its columns are typed `text`, so before Validate the button counts a row the identity endpoint refuses (`INVALID_EMAIL`).
